adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: After the patient becomes tearful and expresses disbelief immediately after a metastatic-cancer diagnosis, the clinician should pause and acknowledge the emotion before continuing complex information.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Immediate regimen detail or continued staging information overloads a distressed patient; definite reassurance is false reassurance; asking the patient to suppress emotion is invalidating. Empathic acknowledgment is uniquely appropriate.
